item.title: Town of New Glasgow approves a Property Tax Exemption for Low-Income Residents | 989 XFM
item.description: The town of New Glasgow has passed a property tax exemption for low-income households. The exemption is to a maximum of $412 for those living in their primary residence whose total household income is no greater than $24,855.
